quarantined_leads.lead: Park City Police Chief Wade Carpenter and former Summit County Sheriff David Edmunds are reportedly cooperating with a criminal obstruction-of-justice investigation tied to an alleged effort to discredit Eric Mainord, a Summit County detective and potential witness in the Kouri Richins murder case; no charges have been filed against Carpenter or Edmunds.
quarantined_leads.source_title: Park City police chief's attorney confirms cooperation with obstruction probe
quarantined_leads.subject_response: Attorney Greg Skordas said Carpenter and Edmunds did not participate in efforts to fabricate or circulate allegations, pressure Mainord to withdraw from the sheriff's race, or interfere with the Richins prosecution. Park City Mayor Ryan Dickey said he had full confidence in Carpenter's leadership. No charges have been filed.
quarantined_leads.reason: The lead concerns an uncharged, ongoing investigation and allegations described through a search warrant. The August 24 report is a single local-news account of the update, and the subjects deny wrongdoing. It is retained for follow-up rather than published; the allegations are not established facts.
